verdict.rationale: The API/platform exposes most core UI capabilities — tool use, code execution, browser/computer/bash tools, MCP connector, Managed Agents for long-running/async tasks, and Skills for document generation (PowerPoint/Excel/Word/PDF) — giving strong parity with UI features like 'connect apps and tools' and 'hand off and schedule tasks' (claude-docs-2, 51-54, 12, 14-15). However, some consumer-UI features advertised on pricing page (claude-docs-22 'Memory across conversations', claude-docs-45 'Projects', 'Claude Design, Slides, Docs') have no documented API/SDK equivalent in the evidence, leaving a real parity gap. Missing for 10: documented API access to persistent cross-conversation memory, Projects-equivalent workspace API, and native Design/Slides/Docs generation endpoints (beyond generic Skills).
